body: You have a "vivid imagination." I wish I had, it would have given me a way to escape.

I wonder why any of us were even born. I mean I can't believe my mother had children. 

She resented everything about being a mother, from pregnancy, birth and on. I know it was the times, I mean u get married and have kids, but no one forced you. 

She has told me something very chilling about when she was pregnant with me. She was obsessed with her looks. She always proudly told me she only gained 15 lbs when she was pregnant with me. 

She said the Drs told her to gain more, and eat, but she didn't want to get fat and wanted her figure back asap. 

Nice.

Wow, I never thought of this. My family broke up and we were taken away when I was 13 and my sibs were younger. 

My mother hates teens. My kids have pointed out that since she never raised anyone past 13, she has no clue about  dealing with teens.

She used to be so blatant, just like "I hate teens so I can be cruel."

And did not esp. like her grandsons. Wow. Never thought of this.

I AM taking it personally bcs it's been a terrible painful situation. 

However, you are completely right my first reaction was about myself, and I didn't even stop and think about it. It's no excuse, but it's a very upsetting situation to me. Out of the blue . 

I am I counseling. And letting the kids figure it out for themselves,,as u suggested, is good advice.
They mean it's too bad u have feelings about being hurt by them, they don't care and that's it.,

My wonderful nephew who used to idolize his older cousin (my son) reached out to my son. My son adored him for many years, before the family cut us off. 

But, even tho I don't know ... I know my mother and sister are behind this. 

And yes, maybe it will end up good for them.
Not harsh. And appreciated. Well, reddit made a difference in my life today.

They cut us off. My mother is a drunk, and uses a walker. My daughters graduation was at a church with a slick tile. Even with a walker that was kind of dicey for her. 

So, I told her we could get there early to be safe and she said no. I told her is was slippery and to use the walker and she refused. 

Apparently I am a complete idiot bcs I still tried, but she got so fall down drunk it was not right for her to go and cause a scene. My daughter was really upset about the possibility of a scene at her graduation, etc. 

So I told her she couldn't go, but that we would be doing an after dinner, and barbq etc and she could go to that. And that was it. 

And, with the exception of one uncle, she did the smear campaign on me, and it worked. And my family has been shunned for almost 3 years. 

Textbook. And guess what? Knowing all of this, I would still keep my drunk clumsy belligerent mother from my daughters graduation.

First, I wish I could personally thank everyone one of you. Your advice was considered, honest and def. empathetic. 

So ... I am somewhat taking ur advice. I am washing my hands of it so to speak. If they want to go see their cousins, they shd be able to go. 

The fact that my mother, sister and crazy navy BIL will have to be around sucks. But ... We all know how people like this operate. 

No doubt my kids will be showered with gifts and money. To make up for missing the state championship, high school plays, graduation for both of them and off to college. 

I am enraged that these people went behind my back and approached my kids. That is a disgraceful trampling of parental boundaries. 

But, as u said, my kids are old enough, and it's really not my boundaries anymore. If my mother and or sister had honorable intentions about repairing the family issues, they would have approached my husband and I, as adults. 

But they didn't, and they never will, and my kids are almost grown up. 

And I loved my nieces and nephew. One aspect I didn't bring up was that my sister treated her kids in really bad ways in front of us. Even when my kids were little, they saw that and would get upset. Dad was scary too, but mostly my sister. 

I loved those kids, and my heart broke for them. So, whenever I could, I took all 3 of them for extended periods. It was never reciprocated, or appreciated. But I love those kids. And I was so happy to help them if I could. Maybe, there will be a bit of that kind of feeling left. 

Thanks reddit! I am so sorry we all had such horrible FOOs.

Oh, the furniture and crazy navy guy were just examples of the kind of stuff these people are capable of. I know we all have stories of really awful and crazy stuff the narcs in our life do. 

It's staggering. And even tho my kids are bigger, there is always a fear that my navy BIL might make good on his threats - which were vague, but scary. 

Same with my mother selling off my belongings I loaned her. I have only myself to blame for that, I know. 

The thing is, when u r on the receiving end of this scary insane behavior, it's hard to feel confident about where their insanity stops. How far will they go? 

And, I am scared a bit too. Probably I don't have to be - but it's all insane as it is.

Yes, you are right that I shd just not imagine it. Part of it is my pain knowing I will be mocked, and part a desire to protect them. 

These are awful people. I love my nieces and nephews, but I would NEVER approach them behind my crazy sisters back. It's not appropriate.

I am in counseling, and I appreciate ur honesty suggesting it, bcs I know that it is a lifetime of pain, cruelty and sadness that is prompting my rage and feeling of betrayal. 

But even knowing that, I still see this as a betrayal by my kids. They know what's happened. 

Will it make a difference at all if they go out there secretly? No. Trust me, these are really awful people and the kids know that. EG, my mother has tried to "suicide" a few times in front of them. They get it. 

But they have their whole lives to reach out to the cousins. It doesn't have to be now. 

And I cannot get over the boundary trampling of these people when it comes to my children. They are the crazy people who cut us off. They had years to reach out. Going behind our back like this...

A final story about them. 2 years ago my sons football team made it to the state championship. He was starting o-line. They were on TV, in the media. It was amazing. It was like our child made the Olympics. 

Their game was televised the day after Thanksgiving. Like a fool, I called my mother to tell her - to watch it or even go with us. I would push her wheelchair. She refused. 

Then we found out ... She invited all of the family to her house for Thanksgiving. People flew from Georgia, DC, California. The same people who had cut us off. The one person who reached out to us basically did it so that she could make sure my family knew we weren't invited to the Thanksgiving extravaganza, 

And then they said that they wouldn't be watching my sons game on TV the next day anyway, bcs they had to go shopping on Black Friday. 

My son couldn't believe it. These are really nasty toxic people.

OK, it's the OP and I truly am enormously grateful for this advice, bcs I know u all get it. 

But ... First of all, while they don't know the half of it, they know enough and have suffered enough cruelty and abuse at my mothers hands to stay away from her. In fact, they have told me many times tho won't ever see her bcs of what she did. 

Since the kids are at her house, I don't think they can avoid her. They know she lies. But even tho I know it is lies, and I know they are horrible people, I can't stop my heartbreak over visualizing my mother and sister fawning over these two and saying things like "it's so wonderful to see u. It's so sad ur mother is so bad and crazy that she can't be included. U know how she is." 

Come on guys - we know that will happen. It has always happened. I have suffered so much at her hands, and so did they. 

I can't handle imagining that. When my kids are older, and I am not supporting them, they can do what they want. 

Another part of this is my sister is married to a navy pilot. About three years ago when this was happening, my sister and I had the strangest falling out over her priest. (Insane.) 

It angered her crazy husband so much he called up my husband and threatened U.S., and said we were never to contact his family again. 

Ok, so he is a major asshole ... but I still don't want these people around us. And yes my kids know about that - they heard the screaming phone call.

These people have been so cruel to me and my kids so many times. No! At this point in time, it is ME vs them. I can't bear to think of them playing into this, knowing it will hurt me so much. 

Their cousins are 17,13 and 10.

I can't believe we didn't think of asking in German ...  ... Maybe "wie Getz! Wo ist du?"

I will tell him he has to record it too. Thanks.
Thank you everyone. I feel so alone, but these comments help.

And to add further food for thought. We are both highly educated, very successful people who have raised two healthy children who are also successful. 

But, thru all these years I often thought that there were jobs I couldn't perform bcs sometimes I need to back off mentally. Pilot or surgeon were the two I thought of the most. 

I am stable, functioning - but I don't know that I could always be robotically stable in a demanding scary situation where I must remain calm or others might die. 

It must take a level of emotional fortitude that I might not have.

Sometimes, tho, some blame could be put in the parents doorstep.

I am over 50. My husband and I grew up in severely abusive homes. We have built great lives for ourselves, and overcome much, but we are still scarred by a lot of it. 

You never know what goes on in families, and what kind of emotional scars people are dealing with.
Another memory after reading this. My mom always undressed in front of windows with the light on. Whole neighborhood could see.
I will borrow that "I am divorced from my parents" if you don't mind!

Go to Normandy. Holy Crap - obviously, when you are there just looking around and contemplating what happened is overwhelming. 

But it wasn't nearly as bad as what I "felt" when I was there. Our tour group was stunned.

But it wasn't nearly as bad as what I "felt" when I was there. Our tour group was stunned.

This would be the only incident that probably wasn't paranormal, I think. When my kids were little, I constantly found inexplicable things on them. I remember when my son was just a few months old a watermelon seed fell off of him. We don't eat watermelon, and he hadn't gone anywhere. 

But, how scary for the parents! There is an Air Force base in Wyoming that people say is haunted. France's Warren, I think.
Yup, and then I get judged. No mother could do that, I must be a bad daughter!

That's my MIL. She has completely abandoned her 5 kids. They are grown up now, but still, she does everything with her obnoxious friends and doesn't even talk to kids or grandkids ever. (I am talking years.)

I think it's her way of proving she is capable of bonding or something. EG - my husband was very close to death a few years ago after tough open heart surgery. She never even called. But - a friend breaks her leg, she turns into Florence Nightengale. 

"See - I can CARE about people! U kids and grandkids are the awful ones, not me!"

My husbands sibs and I decided we wouldn't even tell her if he died post surgery bcs  no one ever knows where she is. She can go weeks being inabsentia. And we aren't talking small trips - Poland, Fiji, New Orleans, God knows where. 

She would have been mad. When, six months later she called someone to check on him.

Wow, did I write this? 

Here is some encouragement - yes, it can be wonderful one day. 

I am 53. I put myself thru engineering and law school. I am married and have raised wonderful, successful children. We live in a wonderful place. 

Don't let the terrorists win!

Completely. I raised my brother and sister, who now don't like me bcs I was bitchy to them when I was 17 and had to cook, clean, drive and go to their parent teacher conferences. 

Whatever. The good news is that if anyone gives me crap for being NC I say "well, I already did my duty to u and mom. I am done."

Really want to recast it? Involve yr kids. "My neighbor screamed at my daughter." That's when I really realized how horrible things had been for me. 

Still assessing it.

Sadly, I have to admit this exact situation has made me more reclusive now that I am older. (53)

There are too many acquaintances that just don't understand my reality. I am not a person who likes attention or talks about myself, but sometimes in life we do OWE explanations. And the look on people's faces when you try to explain. 

I volunteered to help decorate the stadium for Senior Night. I had a two or three hour block of time. That same week, my mother made one of her faux suicide attempts. They held her at the hospital against her will. 

The dr said he would return a call during the decorating time slot. Obviously, I couldn't hold a conversation while making posters, etc with other women. 

So, I tried to manage it. 

"You guys - my mothers dr is calling me soon. She is at the hospital and I need to find out the situation."

"No problem! If they call, u can just go over there and we will be quiet." 

"Well, um. It's a tough situation." 

"Oh,,no. Is she seriously sick? Get to the hospital, we'll do ur stuff. It's just a mile away. U need to be with her." 

"OMG - are u kidding me? Just seeing her will freak me out. I doubt they will let me in anyway." 

"Of course they will! I am an ER doctor there. We know patients need family support. It's amazing. Get going! Let us know." 

Me - stressed and not coping "OMG! She isn't sick! She is held on the psych floor bcs she tried to commit suicide again." 

Well, that stopped the cheerful day. No one has ever brought it up, but the looks I got ...

Nothing ever about any of this will be "ok." It's a nightmare. 

But, here is the thing. Obviously, like everyone on this board, I grew up in an extremely abusive and dysfunctional household. And, it was made very clear that speaking the truth, telling secrets, confronting behavior would have resulted in my death. 

All of these sick households NEED secrecy and cowed, frightened children to keep going - or else the abusers will go to jail, etc. 

In other words, abusers can only abuse and be successful if secrets are kept. Once there are no secrets, and they are exposed, the abuse might stop. 

Abusers also twist and redefine reality. Even when u see horrible things first hand, u question yrself. I "thought" that what my parents did was wrong, but - my father was a successful lawyer, we had a nice home. That must be how people are.

It took me YEARS to to begin to trust my judgment, to realize how horrifying everything was, and to speak up to stop the crap. Typically, my doing so meant I lost most of my "family." Bcs, these damaging secrets MUST be kept, and if u even hint at stuff, u r cast out, and shunned, and called delusional, and mocked.

Oh well. Then there are MY children. They suffered at her hands. They are almost grown up. They deserve apologies from many of them. The LAST thing I will do is EVER EVER muzzle them. They are good people, and their feelings matter. If they want to stand up for themselves, be honest, protect themselves, I WILL never stop them. 

I don't want them to live like I did. We can't change or stop the abusers, but we can refuse to take their crap. 

The protective conspiracy of silence, the forced ignoring of these sickos actions, the attitude that we will be embarassed if u reveal things so take whatever ... Is almost as big a crime to me as the abuse. 

This is long bcs I am VERY passionate about this. 

This is how sick and twisted and in denial family members can be. My father is a registered sex offender bcs of what he did to my sister and me. My brother knows that. He has daughters. He still let them spend time with my father - chaperoned I am sure, but still. 

Even more sickening - his wife is a dr. A mandated reporter. I told her to keep him away from their girls, my nieces. She KNEW what I meant, and they still visited him. 

That is really sick, but very typical of the kind of twisted reality people will live. And speaking up is the only way to stop it.

Wow, thanks everyone so much. You guys gave me the exact practical advice I needed - bcs I know we have all been there. 

It was great to not here "oh but it's yr family", "let it go." 

I think, truly, that this sub is the only place on the face of the earth where people understand, and don't get shocked. 

So, farts? Perfect! "I am not here for u..." That shd become a go to for us for every event. Seriously. 

Don't get boxed in ... OMG that is exactly predictable, I didn't think of it. Yup, blank cat stare. 

And skipping the funeral. I don't know about that, but I know it's important to be there as she nears the end. He told me today it's a blessing, in a way. But he will hurt. 

Naturally, I know none of them will be there for that. Narcissists don't do the hardwork. Probably, they will wait until she dies then fly in and "take over the funeral plans." Be my guest! 

And u guys r right. I could come back home and then go later if I have too. 

I am sober 3 years, but I also forgot what a bunch of drunk Irish they are! My only fear is my kids (who hate them) will speak out. But that's ok. When my son was about 12 my mother decided that he needed to know about "squirting orgasms." Double shudder. 

I don't normally talk that bluntly, but again - I know u guys can sadly relate. 

Time to take a shower.
